_comment: Laminadores conocidos. Rutas con ~ y {app}. Solo se registran rutas verificadas (campo verified); añadir otros sistemas/laminadores al comprobarlos.

orcaslicer.name: OrcaSlicer
orcaslicer._general: Profiles for most brands: the slicer used for printers whose brand has no slicer of its own (makers), and for every printer when the user picks it for all.

quirks._manual_map_max_extruder: OrcaSlicer 2.5 rechaza la asignación manual de filamentos en E3/E4 al laminar (comprobado con su CLI).

orcaslicer.notes: Desde 2.5 los perfiles de sistema instalados van en .opc (formato binario propio, cabecera ZCRO): no se leen; usar el repositorio.

bambustudio.name: Bambu Studio
bambustudio._source_of: Projects of these kinds (read_3mf.detect_source) start from this slicer's system presets: used to show the original value of each designer change.

quirks._bed_types_missing: Plates of rules.BED_TYPES this slicer does not have (s_keys_map_BedType, PrintConfig.cpp).
